FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'good evening' in French? (1 mark)
   A. merci
   B. bonsoir
   C. Enchanté
   D. Monsieur

2. How do you say 'well' in French? (1 mark)
   A. bien
   B. Madame
   C. oui
   D. bonjour

3. How do you say 'the baby' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. le père
   C. la grand-mère
   D. le bébé

4. Fill in: ______ grand-père s'appelle David. (1 mark)
   A. Mon
   B. La
   C. Une
   D. Ma

5. How do you say 'the book' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le sac
   B. le livre
   C. le frigo
   D. la fenêtre

6. How do you say 'the bathroom' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le sac
   B. la maison
   C. la douche
   D. la salle de bain

7. How do you say 'between' in French? (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. dans
   C. entre
   D. derrière

8. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'school'? (1 mark)
   A. école
   B. ecole
   C. écoe
   D. ècole

9. How do you say 'Monday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. vendredi
   C. mardi
   D. jeudi

10. How do you write the number 3 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trois
   B. trente
   C. dix-neuf
   D. onze

11. How do you write the number 25 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. dix-neuf
   D. vingt

12. How do you write the number 5 in French? (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. dix-huit
   C. neuf
   D. trois

13. How do you say 'vegetables' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les haricots
   B. les bonbons
   C. le riz
   D. les légumes

14. How do you say 'fish' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les légumes
   B. les frites
   C. le jus
   D. le poisson

15. How do you say 'black' in French? (1 mark)
   A. noir
   B. grand
   C. court
   D. long

16. How do you say 'the finger' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le cou
   B. le doigt
   C. la jambe
   D. l'épaule

17. How do you say 'the rain' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le temps
   B. le nuage
   C. l'orage
   D. la pluie

18. How do you say 'It is raining.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait chaud.
   B. Il fait beau.
   C. Il y a du vent.
   D. Il pleut.

19. How do you say 'to the right' in French? (1 mark)
   A. près de
   B. à côté de
   C. à droite
   D. à gauche

20. How do you say 'the key' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jardin
   B. le tapis
   C. la clé
   D. le magasin

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into French: 'I have a brother and a sister.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into French: 'My mother is called Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Write a birthday card of four lines to a friend called Njeri. (4 marks) (4 marks)

24. Write the French words for: straight ahead, Excuse me, Go (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into French: 'This is my sister.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

26. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandfather.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Translate into French: 'I have ten fingers.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

28. Write the French words for: maize, vegetables, juice (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'It is the baby.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into French: 'Today it is Monday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into French: 'Turn right.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'It is a cake.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #18 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — bonsoir
   good evening in French is bonsoir.

2. A — bien
   well in French is bien.

3. D — le bébé
   the baby in French is le bébé.

4. A — Mon
   Grand-père is masculine.

5. B — le livre
   the book in French is le livre.

6. D — la salle de bain
   the bathroom in French is la salle de bain.

7. C — entre
   between in French is entre.

8. A — école
   The correct spelling is école, with its accents.

9. A — lundi
   Monday in French is lundi.

10. A — trois
   3 in French is trois.

11. B — vingt-cinq
   25 in French is vingt-cinq.

12. A — cinq
   5 in French is cinq.

13. D — les légumes
   vegetables in French is les légumes.

14. D — le poisson
   fish in French is le poisson.

15. A — noir
   black in French is noir.

16. B — le doigt
   the finger in French is le doigt.

17. D — la pluie
   the rain in French is la pluie.

18. D — Il pleut.
   It is raining. in French is Il pleut..

19. C — à droite
   to the right in French is à droite.

20. C — la clé
   the key in French is la clé.

SECTION B
----

   Answer: J'ai un frère et une sœur.
